company.name: MIDL
company.shortDescription: MIDL is a digital finance company that offers EVM compatibility, functionality of Ethereum dApps to Bitcoin users.
company.description: Midl is a Bitcoin-native infrastructure project that enables developers to build and run decentralized applications (dApps) directly on the Bitcoin network. It provides an EVM-compatible execution layer, allowing smart contracts, DeFi apps, and tokens without bridges or wrapped assets. The platform focuses on scalability, faster confirmations, and seamless Bitcoin wallet integration.

productsAndServices.description: A Bitcoin abstraction layer enabling native execution of Ethereum-compatible decentralized applications directly on the Bitcoin network without asset bridging.
